new_value: Fixed: coap_client.c ported to the Zephyr 4.1.0 coap_client API. The only breakage was the internal mutex member rename send_mutex -> lock (coap_client.h:115); every other pinned internal (requests[] with request_ongoing/coap_request.cb+user_data/is_observe/in_callback atomic) exists unchanged in 4.1.0 (header 92-107), and upstream still guards requests[] mutation with that same mutex (zephyr coap_client.c 358/456/532/549/620/626) and clears in_callback after callbacks (466/952), so the cancel-slot neuter + spin-wait contract is intact. k_mutex_lock/unlock at coap_client.c:182/193 now take &s_client.lock; WARNING block pin updated to v4.1.0 including the rename note. Verification on heft (4.1.0 workspace, native_sim/native/64 ping_l2 config): coap_client.c.obj compiles clean (0 errors, object produced; the only remaining ping_l2 build failures are the unrelated lora_loopback/lora_l2_rx recv_async API drift owned by 0l5j/sb0b). Review: pass 1 found a stale v3.7.0 pin line in the comment block (fixed); passes 2-3 PASS (rename is cosmetic - same k_mutex scope as upstream; spin-wait termination guaranteed via in_callback clear at 466/952; match_idx bounded by ARRAY_SIZE).
